A table nested in a single-cell row renders as its own table

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><th>Summary</th></tr><tr><td>Before<table><tr><th>Item</th><th>Amount</th></tr><tr><td>Alpha</td><td>10</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
